rubrics.text: one side of body during convulsions
alternating with chest affections and dysenteric stools
which corrodes the skin and spreads
slow evolution of rash in eruptive fevers
tightness of chest alternating with asthma
beginning at feet and extending upwards
sudden chill with hair standing on end
sensation as if the skin were hanging
